pointing_one_no.title: POINTING_UP vs ONE vs NO
pointing_one_no.physical_signature: Single extended index finger with curled middle, ring, pinky
pointing_one_no.differentiation_mechanism: Hybrid static-dynamic separation: POINTING_UP is a stable upright index finger in general context; ONE is the same pose in numerical context; NO requires a dynamic multi-frame horizontal oscillation (>= 2 direction reversals). Stationary index fingers are deterministically prevented from being classified as NO.

thumbs_up_down.title: THUMBS_UP vs THUMBS_DOWN
thumbs_up_down.differentiation_mechanism: Thumb elevation relative to wrist and palm pitch: THUMBS_UP exhibits y_thumb < y_wrist (upward), while THUMBS_DOWN exhibits y_thumb > y_wrist (downward) in canonical coordinates.

palm_stop_hello.title: OPEN_PALM vs STOP vs HELLO
palm_stop_hello.differentiation_mechanism: Dynamic motion vs static posture: OPEN_PALM is stationary; STOP is forward-facing barrier push; HELLO exhibits multi-frame horizontal waving oscillation.
